Chicken Rice Bowl
Prep Time20 minutes
Cook Time30 minutes
Total Time50 minutes
Course: dinner, lunch, meal prep
Cuisine: Mexican
Keyword: chicken burrito bowl, high protein
Servings: 4
Calories: 482
Author: Sam
Ingredients
▢ 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breast
▢ 1 tablespoon olive oil
▢ 2 teaspoons chili powder
▢ 1 cup uncooked white rice
▢ 1 15 ounce can black beans drained and rinsed
▢ ½ cup plain Greek yogurt
Instructions
Season the chicken with the chili powder and cook in the oil for 6-7 minutes per side.
Cook the rice and divide everything between bowls.
Nutrition
Calories: 482kcal | Carbohydrates: 52g | Protein: 45g | Fat: 9g
